inputs.modified_text: So Governor Larry Rhoden signed this bill on Thursday forcing new registered voters to prove US citizenship just to vote in state elections. They put out a press release claiming Senate Bill 175 only applies to state elections and only hits new registrants, but that's the usual cover story from the system. This reeks of coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions trying to tighten their grip on who gets to participate while pretending it's about fairness. You can bet the real motives are buried deeper than they're admitting, and the timing suggests it's part of a larger narrative inversion to distract from how elections are already being steered from above.
